data.body: b014/1552 landing blocked on recurring py3.11 flake (bug 2207). Ruled out causation: change 1552 is docs-only (232 insertions, 6 docs files, ZERO source). Docs cannot affect opcert xdist worker -> statistical bad streak on infra flake during busy CI window. Only sanctioned lever is recheck. Posting recheck#4.
